newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 12.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Thursday were higher as shipowners scrambled for supplies amid fresh US/Iraq tensions, traders said. Sellers were unwilling to offer as they expect prices to climb higher, they said. Bunker 180 cst was traded at $122.50 early Thursday but offers edged higher to be quoted at $123-$124 late Thursday. MDO was traded at $210 and gasoil also climb to $220-$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086).
